About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Stomp Under Foot Son Of A Bee Back to results Stomp Under Foot Son Of A Bee Fuzz Compact hand-built fuzz from Big Muff specialist Stomp Under Foot. The Son of a Bee is a compact fuzz from Stomp Under Foot, the Big Muff-focused workshop of Matt Pasquerella. It delivers the thick, saturated fuzz character the builder is known for in a smaller-format enclosure, making it a space-saving way to get his hand-built fuzz tone onto a crowded board. Like the rest of the range it is hand-built in the USA with a focus on vintage-correct voicing and quality parts. It reacts to picking dynamics and guitar volume for a range of thick fuzz voicings.
